title: Hyundai E&C, Hyundai Steel Patent Composite Beam for Data Centers
dek: Hyundai E&C and Hyundai Steel have patented a composite beam for data centres, according to the Seoul Economic Daily.
summary: The Seoul Economic Daily reports that Hyundai Engineering & Construction and Hyundai Steel have patented a composite beam designed for data centres. No excerpt was provided, so technical specifications and commercial plans are not given.
keyFacts: Hyundai E&C and Hyundai Steel patented a composite beam for data centres
whyItMatters: Data-centre construction could become a growing source of structural steel demand, and product development aimed at the segment may help producers capture it.
implications: Structural steel suppliers may increasingly tailor products to data-centre builders. The commercial scale of this product is not indicated in the material.
